status: retrospective saved-data diagnostic; not a new runtime campaign
scope: All eight histories and every emitted report; no outcome-based selection
path: z(s) = z_now + s * v / norm(v), s >= 0
distance_unit: Aitchison distance along the unit ray; not seconds or observation cycles
constraints: R_g/(F_g+R_g) <= rho_g; freeze the policy effective at this report
independent_check: Reconstruct counts from individual events, compute centered-log increments and their EWMA without ILR, continue multiplicatively in the original parts, and find each crossing by bisection of the direct ratio
missingness: No pseudocounts, no interpolation, reset direction after unavailable/nonadjacent windows, retain rather than refilter repeated windows
already_violated: Report current violation with zero remaining admissible distance; do not claim a future first crossing
on_boundary: An outward direction exits immediately at distance zero; inward or tangent motion does not exit that constraint along the positive ray
no_forward_crossing: Explicit status and null distance, representing infinity along this fixed-policy ray rather than missing data
pair_selection: For each group, enumerate every pair of distinct history/window observations with exactly equal F, R and rho and opposite nonzero last-increment directions. Keep the first available report per history/window/policy version. Do not treat pairs as independent replications.
example_selection: The two previously discussed reports, identified by history, window and rho=0.5, are retrospective illustrations, not effect-selected confirmation
